title: MCP modern protocol and connector compatibility
summary: Primary protocol is MCP 2026-07-28 with stateless server/discover, tools/list and tools/call. v0.2-dev1 also accepts initialize-era 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18 and 2025-11-25 clients in stateless compatibility mode so connector scanners can interoperate during rollout.
invariants: Never mint or trust Mcp-Session-Id; initialize-era compatibility is stateless and transport-only.
MCP-Protocol-Version and Mcp-Method must match modern requests; Mcp-Name must match tools/call name.
The seven project tools map to semantic Wire operations in both eras.
MCP clientInfo is diagnostic metadata and never establishes project authority.

provenance.claim: Grounded in sealed MCP Project Service v0.2-dev7 package.
